headline: IAG Anticipates Lower 2026 Capacity While Maintaining Margin Target
summary: International Consolidated Airlines Group expects 2026 capacity to be slightly down but reaffirmed its operating margin target despite ongoing fuel cost headwinds.
why: Airlines navigate fuel price volatility and capacity adjustments to preserve operating margins and shareholder returns.

impacts.name: International Consolidated Airlines Group
impacts.why: Capacity reductions and fuel headwinds impact carrier earnings potential.
